extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors and readers attempting to create or locate a category (here: 'News corrections')
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural checks for creating or locating a Category: namespace page on Wikipedia (e.g., 'News corrections'), including account requirements, search checks, deletion/log checks, and title/redirect considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Login or account required to create page
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account to create this page. Alternatively, you can request the creation of a new category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the category directly, either create an account and then create it, or use the wiki's mechanisms to request that someone else create the category for you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing categories before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Please browse through the existing categories to check if this category is covered under another name. Search for "News corrections" in existing pages within the Category namespace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Category namespace search to avoid duplication; check alternative names and related categories before adding a new one.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect what pages (if any) already link to the proposed category title to determine whether the category is already in use or whether incoming links need retargeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may not appear immediately
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before recreating or reporting a missing category, wait a short period for database updates or use the purge function to refresh cached lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, if appropriate, create redirects from alternative capitalizations to the canonical category page to aid discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if page may have been removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the deletion log to determine whether the category existed and was removed, and review deletion rationale before attempting recreation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empty category notice
rubrics_metrics.description: There are no pages or files in this category. This list may not reflect recent changes (learn more).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An empty category can indicate genuine lack of content, recent deletions, or caching/delay; follow the other listed checks (search, links, deletion log, capitalization) before creating or reporting the category.
